name: Eastern Air Logistics Co., Ltd.
summary: Eastern Air Logistics Co., Ltd. provides air express, comprehensive ground, and multimodal transport services. The company offers air cargo logistics services covering international and domestic airline networks, including cargo aircraft transportation and passenger aircraft bellyhold transportation; ground services, such as assembly, sorting, transfer, and warehousing of flight import and export cargo; assistance in the completion of flight inbound and outbound cargo document information operations; and supporting customs supervision area warehousing services for the inspection of air cargo.
